# WP1 — Domain service (workflow.py + work_items move/route)

## DESIGN

New module `src/mem_mcp/mindmap/workflow.py` owns all team-workflow rules; extends `work_items.py` with stage-aware move + legacy resolution; both follow `work_items.py` patterns (`asyncpg.Connection`, `WorkItemError` subclasses, `channel: Literal["mcp","web"]`, `_load_map`/`_append_history`/`_check_permission`/`log_event`/`get_team_role`, RLS `tenant_id = $n`). Uses WP0 tables (`team_workflows`..`workflow_signoffs`) + `work_items.workflow_id/current_stage` + `work_item_history` extensions.

**New interfaces (consumed by WP2):**
- `create_team_workflow(conn, tenant_id, team_id, name, created_by, stages, transitions) -> UUID`
- `activate_workflow(conn, workflow_id, team_id) -> None` (sets active, bumps version)
- `get_workflow(conn, workflow_id) -> Workflow`
- `propose_move(conn, tenant_id, team_id, map_key, node_id, to_stage, reason, proposer_tenant_id, channel) -> WorkItem` — writes `workflow_signoff_requests`; item does NOT advance when `requires_signoff`; signatory must not be owner/proposer (`SignoffExcluded`); role restriction (`signoff_roles`) still applies; blank reason with `requires_reason` → `ReasonRequiredError`.
- `sign_workflow_move(conn, request_id, signatory_tenant_id) -> None` — appends `workflow_signoffs`; when distinct signatories reach `signoff_min`, commits `current_stage` + `work_item_history` `'stage'` row.
- `cancel_workflow_move(conn, request_id, canceler_tenant_id) -> None` — status `cancelled`.
- `remap_workflow_stages(conn, old_workflow_id, new_stage_map) -> None`
- `materialise_legacy_workflow(conn, team_id) -> UUID` — lazy, idempotent `INSERT … ON CONFLICT` from `WORK_STATUSES`/`TRANSITIONS` (`work_items.py:29-47`).
- `compute_item_moves(conn, tenant_id, team_id, map_key, node_id) -> ItemMoves` — `allowed_moves`, `blocked_reason`, pending sign-off count/state (uses `workflow_transitions` + `work_item_history`).
- `list_pending_signoffs_for_user(conn, tenant_id, signatory_tenant_id) -> list[PendingSignoff]`

**work_items.py additions:**
- `move_work_item(conn, tenant_id, team_id, map_key, node_id, to_stage, reason, expected_stage, channel) -> WorkItem` — resolves workflow (`_resolve_workflow`: item `workflow_id` else team active else legacy), validates transition against `workflow_transitions`, enforces reason/signoff, appends history (`stage_before`/`stage_after`/`workflow_id`, `change_type='stage'`).
- `_resolve_workflow(conn, item_row, team_id) -> Workflow` — reads `work_items.workflow_id` or materialises legacy.
- Wire `set_work_item_status`/`mark`/`set_kind`: if `work_items.workflow_id IS NOT NULL` route through `move_work_item`→`propose_move`, else legacy `TRANSITIONS`; if sign-off required and not satisfied, raise `MoveBlockedError` (reused from `work_items.py:140` pattern, mapped in WP2).

**Errors (new subclasses of `WorkItemError` in `workflow.py`):** `WorkflowError`, `MoveBlockedError`, `ReasonRequiredError` (reuse existing `work_items.py:140`), `SignoffRequiredError`, `SignoffCompleteError`. Mapped in WP2 (`_work_item_common.py::map_work_item_error`).

**Columns / index from WP0:** `work_items.workflow_id` (nullable FK NO ACTION), `work_items.current_stage`; index `(tenant_id,team_id,current_stage)`; `work_item_history.stage_before/stage_after/workflow_id`; `change_type` extended.

**Patterns followed:** `work_items.py:55-140` exceptions; `work_items.py:246-260` transition validation; `work_items.py:1078` status check; `service.py:63` resolve; `auth/rbac.py:28` `get_team_role`; `auth/permissions.py:35` `TEAM_WRITE_MEMORY`; RLS `safe_current_tenant_id()` (0034); append-only history (0046); `channel` audit call.

## TASKS
